# Net Forge survivor template (EMBERWATCH)

> A co-op survivor-like for 4 players and up to 2,000 enemies. You change
> the game by editing src/game.ts only. The template already has waves,
> weapons, XP gems, level-ups, bosses, co-op revive, netcode, rendering,
> touch controls, earn and the store. Do not write renderers, netcode or
> physics.

## Files

- src/game.ts: THE GAME. Declarations against @netforge/engine:
  game(), prefab(), weapon(), upgrade(), director(), system(), earn.rule(),
  store.sku().
- packages/engine/GAME-DESIGN.md: the design rules the playtest gate scores
  (quiet opening, off-screen spawns, i-frames, telegraphs, fast levels).
- client/names.ts: display names for weapon, upgrade and earn ids (labels).
- Models come from the asset library (real CC0 models; the full list of ids is in your instructions). client/library.ts holds the fallback shapes drawn until a model loads.
- Everything else is template machinery.

## Rules the build enforces

- Asset ids look like "style.lowpoly.ghost", never URLs or paths, and must be in the asset library.
- game({ style }) is the art style the creator picked: lowpoly, toon, ps1, pixel, voxel or handdrawn. Keep it. The template draws everything in it, and a "style.lowpoly.<name>" id draws as that style's own model of the same name when the style has one.
- Ids are lower_snake_case.
- Every game declares at least one earn.rule (mandatory earn) and one earn.stake (the buy-in run).
- A survivor game needs one enemy prefab, one weapon and players.weapon.
- Drops must be pickup prefabs. At most 15 weapons (evolutions count) and 8 upgrades.
- Run `pnpm --filter @netforge/template-survivor test` (playtest bots).

## Units

Seconds, metres, metres per second, hit points. Tick rate 30 Hz. Keepers
run at 7 m/s; keep chasers at 3-4 m/s and fast ones under 6.

## Pacing: the spawn director

The director spawns every enemy just off screen (never on it) on the run's
clock. Curves are a number or [seconds, value] keyframes, linear between.

director({
  start: 8,                                     // enemies at 0:00
  alive: [[0, 12], [60, 45], [180, 160], [300, 400], [540, 1600]],  // living target
  rate: [[0, 0.8], [60, 2], [180, 6], [300, 14], [540, 60]],      // spawns per second
  health: [[0, 1], [60, 1.4], [180, 2.4], [540, 5.7]],            // new enemies' health x
  damage: [[0, 1], [180, 1.45], [540, 2.3]],
  xp: [[0, 1], [540, 2]],
  pool: [
    { prefab: "shade", weight: 10 },
    { prefab: "gnat", from: 45, weight: 2, group: [8, 12] },      // a stream from one side
    { prefab: "husk", from: 90, weight: 3 },
  ],
  fade: { after: 260, weight: 0.3 },            // old enemy types thin out
});

speed: [[0, 1], [240, 1], [600, 1.6]] makes every non-boss enemy faster late
in the run, so endless kiting stops working.
More players raise alive and rate by perPlayer (0.6 each); a living boss
halves the rate (whileBoss). At the cap new spawns get tougher instead of
adding bodies (crowded). Enemies left far behind are moved back ahead of
the players (recycle). ahead (0.35) is the share spawned where you are going.

## Common changes

### Make it harder or easier
Raise or lower the director's alive, rate, health or damage keyframes after
the first minute; keep 0:00 quiet. Easier also: players.hitIframes (0.5 s),
players.magnet (4 m), a longer starting weapon range.

### Add an enemy
prefab("wisp", { model: "style.lowpoly.bat", health: 8, speed: 5, radius: 0.25, damage: 4, ai: "chase", drops: ["ember_small"] });
then add it to the director's pool from the minute it should join:
{ prefab: "wisp", from: 150, weight: 3 }
or spawn a set piece from a system, just off screen:
after(240, () => spawnEdge("wisp", { count: 60, side: "north" }));
ai is the enemy's role. Every big hit is telegraphed on the ground first:
- "chase" (default), "tank" (a chaser; give it mass), "idle"/"none" (stands still)
- "runner": aims where you will be. Fast, fragile.
- "charger": stops inside 6 m, shows a lane 0.55 s, then charges along it.
- "ranged": keeps its distance, shows an aim line, fires a slow dodgeable shot
  (only with a clear line: pillars are cover).
- "bomber": walks up, arms a 1 s fuse circle, explodes (hurts enemies too).
- "shielder" / "healer": every few seconds shields or heals nearby allies.
- "summoner": keeps away and calls adds: attack: { summon: "gnat", count: 2 }.
- "flee", "wander".
Tune a role with attack: { damage, range, windup, cooldown, speed, radius, summon, count }:
prefab("spitter", { model: "style.lowpoly.frog", health: 20, speed: 2.8, ai: "ranged", attack: { damage: 8, range: 10, speed: 7 }, drops: ["ember_small"] });
A splitter bursts into smaller enemies on death:
prefab("brood", { model: "style.lowpoly.slime_green", health: 40, speed: 3, split: { into: "shade", count: 3 }, drops: ["ember_small"] });

### Add elites
director({ ..., elites: { from: 90, every: [45, 60] } }) spawns an elite from the
current pool: x6 health, x1.5 damage, x5 XP, a gold rim. From a system:
spawnEdge("husk", { count: 1, elite: true }).

### Add a weapon
weapon("frost_ring", {
  kind: "nova", damage: 6, cooldown: 0.8, range: 5, knockback: 8,
  levels: [{ damage: "+30%" }, { range: "+15%" }, { cooldown: "-15%" }, { damage: "+30%" }, { knockback: 3 }],
});
kinds:
- "nova": a burst in range; "aura": a field that burns what is inside, every cooldown
- "bolt": count projectiles at the nearest enemy (speed, pierce)
- "orbit": count blades at range metres, speed rad/s
- "cone": a sweep of spread degrees where the keeper faces (360: all around)
- "chain": strikes the nearest, then jumps count times, each within speed m
- "meteor": count circles of blast m land on enemies in range, 0.6 s after showing
- "boomerang": flies out range m and back, hitting everything both ways
levels: what each level changes from the one before (5-8 levels). A number
adds (count: 1, pierce: 2, cooldown: -0.1 s), a percent scales ("+40%").
Cards show these changes ("+1 projectile, -20% cooldown"). It is offered at
level-up automatically. Add a label in client/names.ts.

### Add an evolution
weapon("frost_ring", { ..., evolve: { into: "blizzard", requires: "iron_skin" } });
weapon("blizzard", { kind: "nova", damage: 20, cooldown: 0.6, range: 9, knockback: 12 });
At max level, with the passive "iron_skin" taken, the "blizzard" card always
shows; it replaces frost_ring in its slot. Evolutions are never offered on
their own. Give them about x1.7 damage and a new shape (360 degrees, double
radius, more count). Pair each base weapon with a different passive.

### Add a passive
upgrade("iron_skin", { stat: "armor", step: 1, maxLevel: 4 });
stats: speed, maxHealth, magnet, might, haste, regen, armor, area (bigger
novas, auras, cones, meteors and orbits), amount (more projectiles, blades,
jumps and meteors). Up to 8. maxLevel caps how often it is offered.

### Add pickups and loot
prefab("hearth_meal", { model: "style.lowpoly.cell_heal", health: 1, speed: 0, kind: "pickup", pickup: { effect: "heal", amount: 0.3 } });
A boss's hoard: pickup: { effect: "chest", amount: 3, evolve: true }. Bosses
drop it instead of the plain chest. If the player holds a weapon and already
has its paired passive, that weapon jumps to max level, so its evolution is
on the cards.
effects: heal (amount: fraction of max health, or hit points above 1),
vacuum (every gem on the floor comes to you), bomb (clears the screen's
non-boss enemies), chest (amount card picks; a ready evolution shows first).
Drop them with a chance: drops: ["ember_small", { id: "hearth_meal", chance: 0.012 }].
Elites always drop the game's chest; bosses drop a heal, a vacuum and a chest.
Above 300 gems on the floor, new gems merge into the nearest one.

### Add props (breakables)
prefab("ember_urn", { model: "style.lowpoly.barrel", health: 25, speed: 0, radius: 0.5, prop: true, drops: ["ember_mid", { id: "hearth_meal", chance: 0.3 }] });
then scatter("ember_urn", 45) from a system. Props never move, never hurt
and never count as enemies.

### A bigger field
game({ ..., field: { halfSize: 100, pillars: [[14, 14, 2], [32, 0, 3], ...] } })
(20-120 m; pillars are [x, z, radius]).

### Add events and moments
system("events", ({ every, after, announce, spawnEdge, xpBoost, surge, clear, bossAlive, random }) => {
  after(240, () => every(75, () => {
    if (bossAlive()) return;                       // events wait for bosses
    announce("THE TIDE RISES", { tone: "danger" }); // a big banner for everyone
    spawnEdge("shade", { count: 220, side: "north", spread: 80 });
    surge(1.5, 20);                                 // or xpBoost(2, 30), pauseDirector(10)
  }));
});
Never fire the same event twice in a row. announce tones: info, danger,
reward. Off-screen bosses get an edge arrow automatically. Game events you
can key on (and earn rules too): miniboss.killed, boss.killed,
player.evolved, heal.collected, vacuum.collected, bomb.collected,
chest.collected. clear("lantern_thief") removes a prefab at once (an event
ends) with no kills or drops.

### Cards
Weighted: an owned weapon's next level 8, a new weapon 10 (while a slot is
free), a passive 4 (7 once weapon slots are full); a ready evolution always
shows. players.rerolls (default 1) rerolls per run (R); Skip (X) trades the
cards for a small heal. When everything is maxed, a level heals and gives
teammates a little XP.

### Add a boss
prefab("lantern_eater", {
  model: "style.lowpoly.trex", appearance: { tint: "#c2410c", scale: 1.2 }, health: 30000, speed: 2, radius: 2, damage: 40,
  boss: { attacks: ["slam", "ring", "dash", "summon"], summon: "shade", enrageAt: 0.5 },
  drops: ["ember_large"],
});
after(480, () => spawnEdge("lantern_eater", { count: 1 })) from a system;
on("boss.killed", () => end("won")).
Attacks (all telegraphed): slam (circle around it), dash (11 m lane), leap
(lands on a circle at you), rain (circles near players), ring (14 shots
outward), fan (7 shots at you), summon (adds). It switches near and far
modes every 4-9 s; below enrageAt health it is faster and throws more.
A mini-boss: boss: { attacks: [...], rank: "mini" } raises "miniboss.killed"
(not "boss.killed", so it never ends the run). Boss health scales with
players present (players.bossHealthPerPlayer, 0.55); every boss gets a HUD
bar and drops a burst of gems worth 1-2 levels.

### Change pacing
The director's curves set the crowd; BOSS_AT sets the boss. A wave on the
HUD is a minute: the run system emits wave.cleared every 60 s (earn rules
count it). The XP curve is players.xp { base, growth, exponent }: XP to go
from L to L+1 is base + growth x (L - 1)^exponent. Aim for level 2 within
10 s, level 5 at 1:00, level 10 at 3:00.

### Add an earn rule
earn.rule("survivor_5", { when: "wave.cleared", n: 5, pay: 10, oncePer: "run" });
Events: wave.cleared (you emit it), enemy.killed (credits the killer),
boss.killed (everyone present), player.downed, player.revived (credits the
reviver), player.levelup, run.won, run.lost, and anything you emit().
Each rule pays once per run per player, in coins; the room server is the referee.

### The buy-in run (required)
earn.stake({ min: 20, max: 200, multiple: 2 });
Every game declares one, on one top-level line; a game without it does not
build. A player stakes coins at the start of a run (the Kit spends them as
coins.spend(amount, "stake"), then the client calls conn.stake()). The room
fixes the stake when the next run starts. A staked run pays its normal earn
plus a share of stake x multiple: the share is the part of the run's most
earn the player makes. What it does not win back stays in the reward pool.
multiple is 1 to 2. "stake" is reserved: never a SKU or meta upgrade id.

### Losable gear (optional)
store.sku("ember_charm", { coins: 150, grants: { gear: "kindling", loseBelow: 0.25 } });
Gear is owned in the player's profile and sells for coins only. It brings one
level of its declared upgrade into every staked run, and is lost when that run
makes less than loseBelow of its most earn. Its coins stay in the reward pool.

### Coins: earn and the store

Every game has coins: 1 coin = 1 of the game's own token, and players see
them under the token's own name, symbol and logo (never "coins" or "tokens"
as a label). Earn rules pay coins (`pay` is whole coins). The recommended
coin model (the default, no declaration) sells cosmetics, unlocks and
in-run consumables, never permanent stat power:

store.sku("revive", { coins: 50 });                                   // in-run: used while downed
store.sku("skin_aurora", { coins: 300, grants: { cosmetic: 1 } });    // a look, owned for good

Keep both exactly: the client is wired to them (price and look id). Owned
looks and unlocks are saved on the room server in the player's profile. Players spend
earned coins first (instantly, no wallet prompt), then their wallet. Before
the game launches coins are play money; the Kit switches by itself, so
nothing in game.ts depends on it. Price in coins against what a run pays
(the four rules here pay up to 80 a run): a revive is under a run, a
cosmetic a few runs.

### Sell a keeper unlock (a character, a starting loadout, a sidegrade)
keeper("tinker", { name: "Tinker", text: "Turrets and a wide glass.", weapon: "spark_bolt", passive: "lantern_glass" });   // no unlock
store.sku("unlock_tinker", { coins: 400, grants: { keeper: "tinker" } });
A keeper is earned (unlock: an achievement) or bought (a SKU), never both:
the build refuses a sold keeper that also declares an unlock. Never sell
the first keeper (everyone's free default). An unlock is a different way to
play, never more power. Before launch coins are play money and buy only
in-run items; looks and unlocks open at launch.

### Cosmetics only ("no pay to win")
economy({ store: "cosmetics" });
Then every SKU must be a look (grants: { cosmetic: n }); drop revive.

### Permanent upgrades for coins (opt-in meta upgrades)
economy({ metaUpgrades: true });
metaUpgrade("hearth", { stat: "maxHealth", step: 0.05, levels: 3, cost: 120, growth: 2 });  // 120, 240, 480 coins
metaUpgrade("stride", { stat: "speed", step: 0.03, levels: 3, cost: 100, growth: 1.8 });
Only when the creator asks for permanent upgrades. Stats: speed, maxHealth,
magnet, might, haste, area. The engine refuses more than +15% to one stat
or +30% in all, more than 5 levels, or growth under 1.5, and applies a
player's levels at the start of every run. The store shows each level.

### Add a keeper (a playable character)
keeper("sparkwright", { name: "Sparkwright", text: "Bolts at range, and quicker hands.", model: "style.lowpoly.rogue", tint: "#7ad7ff", weapon: "spark_bolt", passive: "bellows", unlock: "five_minutes" });
A keeper starts every run with its weapon and its passive at level 1;
players pick one before their first level and on the end screen. At most
15; the first declared keeper is everyone's default, and at least one
keeper has no unlock (declare a free one first). Keepers unlock with
achievements, or with coins through a SKU with grants: { keeper }. The room
server checks every pick against the player's saved unlocks.
With keepers declared, players.weapon is optional.

### Add achievements, daily goals and end-screen titles
achievement("evolver", { title: "Evolved", text: "Evolve a weapon.", when: "player.evolved" });
mission("elite", { text: "Kill an elite", when: "elite.killed" });
title("butcher", { text: "The Butcher", most: "kills" });
Achievements and missions count a game event per player in one run (n
times) and pay nothing (coins come only from earn rules). The room server
grants them from the run and saves them per player (wallet, or guest until
sign-in), so they follow the player to every device. The HUD shows
three missions a day. Titles rank players at the end of a run by most or
least of: kills, damage, revives, downs, level, pickups. Events to count:
anything you emit ("tide.survived"), "<prefab>.killed"
("lantern_thief.killed"), "elite.killed", "player.evolved",
"player.revived", "chest.collected", "miniboss.killed", "boss.killed",
"wave.cleared".

### Co-op that feels shared
players: { share: "nearby" }        // default: half of each gem to teammates within 20 m
players: { share: "all" }           // or "collector", or { mode, fraction, radius }
players: { reviveBuff: { seconds: 5, damage: 1.3, speed: 1.15 } }  // the reviver burns hotter
players: { downed: { seconds: 10, crawl: 0.35, selfRevives: 1, respawn: 5 } }  // the default: a short down, a crawl, one free get-up (Space), back in 5 s beside a teammate
players: { lateJoinBehind: 2 }      // a late joiner starts 2 levels under the team, cards waiting
players: { crit: { chance: 0.08, multiplier: 2 } }  // crits show as gold numbers
The end screen votes "Play again" (everyone ready starts the next run; it
starts by itself after 10 s) and shows each keeper's build, damage per
weapon, what downed them, coins and titles.

### Make co-op 8 players
players.max: 8. The hosted Net Forge room server seats at most 8 in a
co-op room, so 8 is the most a game can ask for.

## Models and appearances (the asset library)

Every model is a real CC0 model from the asset library, by id. Enemies are
drawn about 3.2 hit radii tall, keepers 1.8 m; animated ones walk, run and
die by themselves. An appearance dresses a model into your own original:
appearance: { tint: "#rrggbb", accent: "#rrggbb", scale: 0.4 to 3, parts: up to 4 }.

### Make enemies look like slimes
prefab("shade", { model: "style.lowpoly.slime_green", ... });
prefab("husk", { model: "style.lowpoly.slime_spiky", ... });
prefab("brute", { model: "style.lowpoly.slime_pink", appearance: { scale: 1.3 }, ... });

### Add a monster truck (or any vehicle)
prefab("crusher", { model: "style.lowpoly.monster_truck", health: 400, speed: 3, radius: 1.2, damage: 20, ai: "chase", mass: 10, drops: ["ember_mid"] });

### A hero described by the creator
players: { prefab: "style.lowpoly.worker", appearance: { tint: "#2e7d32", accent: "#3b2a1a", parts: ["mustache", "hat_cap"] }, ... }
Name it something new in names.json. A creature the library lacks: the
nearest base plus parts, e.g. model "style.lowpoly.shiba" with
appearance { tint: "#5ec8ff", parts: ["antenna", "tail_bolt"] }.

## Look and feel (engine render stack and feel kit)

How the game looks and how hits feel are declarations too. They are
presentation only (never the simulation), so tune them freely. The full
reference is packages/engine/llms.txt.

### Change the look
game({ ..., look: { preset: "dusk", bloom: 1.4, fog: 0.3, tint: "#ffd9a0" } });
presets: "night" (default), "dusk", "day", "studio". Also shadows (off here unless
look.shadows is true), outline,
exposure, saturation, contrast, vignette.

### Make a death or a hit feel bigger
prefab("brute", { ..., feel: { particles: "burst", decal: "scorch", sound: "boom", shake: 0.5, hitStop: 0.06, color: "#ff4d5e" } });
Without feel, big enemies (bosses, radius 0.5 m or more) burst, scorch and
shake, and small ones burst, splat and crunch.

### Make a weapon's impacts feel different
weapon("frost_ring", { ..., feel: { particles: "magic", decal: "ring", color: "#7ad7ff", shake: 0.1 } });
Novas use it when they go off; bolts and lances when they hit.

### Heavier or lighter knockback
weapon knockback (m/s) pushes enemies, divided by their mass. Knocked
enemies stagger, slide, bounce off pillars and shove the enemies behind
them. Bolts stop at pillars.

## Systems API

every(seconds, n => ...), after(seconds, fn), onTick(fn), spawn(prefab, [x,y,z], { elite? }),
spawnPickup(prefab, [x,y,z]), announce(text, { tone }), bossAlive(),
pauseDirector(seconds), surge(multiplier, seconds), xpBoost(multiplier, seconds),
scatter(prefab, count), clear(prefab), upcoming(label, seconds) (a HUD countdown:
upcoming("THE BELL WARDEN", 240)),
spawnEdge(prefab, { count, around?, side?, spread?, scale? }) (just off screen;
side: "any" | "ahead" | "behind" | "north" | "south" | "east" | "west"),
spawnRing(prefab, { count, radius, around? }), alive(prefab?), players(),
emit(event), on(event, players => ...), respawnDead(), end("won" | "lost"),
random(), tick(), time().

## Test

engine.test.run({ ticks: 30 * 180, bots: 4, assert: [...] }) plays the game
on the server sim with bots and reports kills, wave, maxLevel, earned by
rule, deaths, runs won and lost, softlock and ms per tick. With
bot: "human" a human-like bot plays (200 ms reactions, kiting, a second per
card) and report.fun has the fun metrics: first threat, first level,
level at 1/3/6/9 minutes, downs before 1:00, enemies on screen at 0:30,
touches in minute 1, spawns on screen, survival. Net Forge's gate scores
them; `pnpm --filter @netforge/template-survivor fun` prints the table.

## Worked example: src/game.ts

The whole game as the template ships it. Every change starts from this file.

```ts
/**
 * EMBERWATCH: the survivor-like co-op template.
 *
 * One lantern against the dark, growing into a bonfire. Four keepers hold
 * a field at night. The opening is a handful of shades; the swarm grows by
 * the minute until thousands flood the field, and at ten minutes the Bell
 * Warden comes. Weapons fire by themselves; gems from fallen enemies level
 * you up; pick one of three upgrades; stand next to a downed teammate to
 * revive them.
 *
 * This file is the whole game as the model writes it: declarations only,
 * against the typed API in @netforge/engine. Everything else (sim,
 * netcode, renderer, referee) is the template's machinery. Design rules:
 * packages/engine/GAME-DESIGN.md.
 */
import { achievement, director, earn, game, keeper, mission, prefab, store, system, title, upgrade, weapon } from "@netforge/engine";

export default game({
  template: "survivor",
  style: "lowpoly",
  places: { field: { chunks: "places/field", spawn: [0, 1, 0] } },
  // A 150 x 150 m field: room to move, with stone pillars to kite around.
  field: {
    halfSize: 75,
    pillars: [
      [14, 14, 2], [-14, 14, 2], [14, -14, 2], [-14, -14, 2],
      [32, 0, 3], [-32, 0, 3], [0, 32, 3], [0, -32, 3],
      [55, 40, 3], [-55, 40, 3], [55, -40, 3], [-55, -40, 3],
      [40, 62, 2.5], [-40, 62, 2.5], [40, -62, 2.5], [-40, -62, 2.5],
      [66, 0, 3], [-66, 0, 3], [0, 66, 3], [0, -66, 3],
    ],
  },
  players: {
    prefab: "style.lowpoly.hooded_adventurer",
    max: 4,
    weapon: "ember_nova",
    // Level 2 after 2 gems, then a level every 6-10 s early; the exponent keeps late levels meaningful.
    xp: { base: 2, growth: 2, exponent: 2.6 },
    magnet: 4,
    hitIframes: 0.7,
    // Co-op: half of every gem goes to teammates within 20 m, so the team levels together.
    share: "nearby",
    // One hit in twelve lands twice as hard (the numbers show it in gold).
    crit: { chance: 0.08, multiplier: 2 },
    // Whoever revives a teammate burns hotter for a few seconds.
    reviveBuff: { seconds: 5, damage: 1.3, speed: 1.15 },
    // Bosses grow 40% per extra keeper (a squad spreads its fire; 55% made the first fight drag in co-op).
    bossHealthPerPlayer: 0.4,
    // Going down is short: 10 s downed (you can crawl), one free get-up a run (Space), then back in 5 s beside a teammate.
    downed: { seconds: 10, crawl: 0.35, selfRevives: 1, respawn: 5 },
  },
});

// Enemies. Health in hit points, speed in m/s (keepers run at 7), radius in m, damage per touch.
// Each role joins the run on its own minute (see the director), one new idea at a time.
// Fodder sometimes drops a meal (heal), a lodestar (pulls every gem) or a flare (clears the screen).
const LUCK = [{ id: "hearth_meal", chance: 0.012 }, { id: "lodestar", chance: 0.008 }, { id: "flare", chance: 0.006 }];
// The first enemies are warm embers-gone-wrong: orange against the cold floor, so you read them at a glance.
prefab("shade", { model: "style.lowpoly.ghost", appearance: { tint: "#ff8a3d", accent: "#ffd27a" }, health: 20, speed: 3.8, radius: 0.35, damage: 6, ai: "chase", drops: ["ember_small", ...LUCK] });
prefab("gnat", { model: "style.lowpoly.bee", appearance: { tint: "#ffc24a" }, health: 9, speed: 5.6, radius: 0.25, damage: 3, ai: "runner", drops: ["ember_small", ...LUCK] });
prefab("husk", { model: "style.lowpoly.mushroom_imp", health: 45, speed: 2.6, radius: 0.5, damage: 10, ai: "tank", mass: 3, drops: ["ember_mid"] });
prefab("spitter", { model: "style.lowpoly.frog", appearance: { tint: "#6f9a4e", scale: 0.4 }, health: 20, speed: 2.8, radius: 0.4, damage: 5, ai: "ranged", attack: { damage: 8, range: 10, speed: 7 }, drops: ["ember_small"] });
prefab("ram", { model: "style.lowpoly.triceratops", health: 40, speed: 3, radius: 0.45, damage: 12, ai: "charger", drops: ["ember_mid"] });
prefab("bloat", { model: "style.lowpoly.slime_pink", health: 18, speed: 3.2, radius: 0.45, damage: 8, ai: "bomber", attack: { radius: 2.5, damage: 28 }, drops: ["ember_small"] });
prefab("aegis", { model: "style.lowpoly.mech", health: 35, speed: 3, radius: 0.4, damage: 6, ai: "shielder", drops: ["ember_mid"] });
prefab("mender", { model: "style.lowpoly.blob_wizard", health: 30, speed: 3, radius: 0.4, damage: 6, ai: "healer", drops: ["ember_mid"] });
prefab("brute", { model: "style.lowpoly.orc_brute", health: 160, speed: 2.2, radius: 0.8, damage: 18, ai: "tank", mass: 6, drops: ["ember_mid", "ember_mid"] });
prefab("brood", { model: "style.lowpoly.slime_green", health: 40, speed: 3, radius: 0.5, damage: 8, ai: "chase", split: { into: "shade", count: 3 }, drops: ["ember_small"] });
prefab("caller", { model: "style.lowpoly.imp", health: 45, speed: 2.6, radius: 0.4, damage: 6, ai: "summoner", attack: { summon: "gnat", count: 2 }, drops: ["ember_mid"] });

// Bosses. The Ash Matron at 1:45, the Gloam Ram at 4:30, the Bell Warden at 10:00. Every attack is telegraphed.
// The Matron is the first real fight: a winged silhouette no mob shares, two attacks to learn
// (a slam ring around her, a fan of embers at you), about 45 s solo, and a hoard chest when she falls.
prefab("ash_matron", {
  model: "style.lowpoly.dragon",
  appearance: { tint: "#5d5551", accent: "#ff6a2a" },
  health: 290,
  speed: 2.6,
  radius: 1.5,
  damage: 16,
  boss: { attacks: ["slam", "fan"], rank: "mini" },
  drops: ["ember_large"],
});
prefab("gloam_ram", {
  model: "style.lowpoly.trex",
  appearance: { tint: "#5b3a8c", accent: "#c9a7ff" },
  health: 1500,
  speed: 2.8,
  radius: 1.5,
  damage: 22,
  boss: { attacks: ["dash", "leap", "rain"], rank: "mini" },
  drops: ["ember_large"],
});
prefab("bell_warden", {
  model: "style.lowpoly.mushroom_king",
  health: 14500,
  speed: 2.4,
  radius: 1.8,
  damage: 30,
  // The bell tolls: slams, rings of shards, a charge down a lane, and shades called to its side.
  boss: { attacks: ["slam", "ring", "dash", "summon"], summon: "shade", enrageAt: 0.5 },
  drops: ["ember_large"],
});

// The Lantern Thief: an event's runaway carrier. It flees; catch it for a chest.
prefab("lantern_thief", { model: "style.lowpoly.fox", appearance: { tint: "#ffd36b" }, health: 140, speed: 6.2, radius: 0.45, damage: 0, ai: "flee", drops: [{ id: "ember_chest", chance: 1 }] });

// Props: break them for gems and luck. Scattered over the field at the start. Stumps and campfires
// come from the same Kenney Nature Kit as the treeline, so the field reads as one place.
prefab("ember_urn", { model: "style.lowpoly.stump", health: 25, speed: 0, radius: 0.5, damage: 0, prop: true, drops: ["ember_small", { id: "hearth_meal", chance: 0.12 }, { id: "lodestar", chance: 0.04 }] });
prefab("brazier", { model: "style.lowpoly.campfire", health: 60, speed: 0, radius: 0.6, damage: 0, prop: true, drops: ["ember_mid", { id: "hearth_meal", chance: 0.25 }, { id: "ember_chest", chance: 0.1 }] });

// Special pickups. Elites always drop a chest; bosses drop a meal, a lodestar and a chest.
prefab("hearth_meal", { model: "style.lowpoly.cell_heal", health: 1, speed: 0, kind: "pickup", pickup: { effect: "heal", amount: 0.25 } });
prefab("lodestar", { model: "style.lowpoly.crystal", health: 1, speed: 0, kind: "pickup", pickup: { effect: "vacuum" } });
prefab("flare", { model: "style.lowpoly.grenade", health: 1, speed: 0, kind: "pickup", pickup: { effect: "bomb" } });
prefab("ember_chest", { model: "style.lowpoly.chest", health: 1, speed: 0, kind: "pickup", pickup: { effect: "chest", amount: 2 } });
// A boss's hoard: three picks, and a weapon you hold with its paired passive jumps to max so it evolves.
prefab("hoard_chest", { model: "style.lowpoly.chest", appearance: { tint: "#ffcf5a", scale: 1.6 }, health: 1, speed: 0, kind: "pickup", pickup: { effect: "chest", amount: 3, evolve: true } });

// Gems (pickups): the XP each is worth.
prefab("ember_small", { model: "style.lowpoly.gem_small", health: 1, speed: 0, kind: "pickup", value: 1 });
prefab("ember_mid", { model: "style.lowpoly.gem_mid", health: 1, speed: 0, kind: "pickup", value: 6 });
prefab("ember_large", { model: "style.lowpoly.gem_large", health: 1, speed: 0, kind: "pickup", value: 60 });

// Weapons fire by themselves. Cooldowns in seconds, ranges in metres.
// Each level is a named change the card shows; at max level, with its paired
// passive taken, a weapon evolves (the card always shows). 8 weapons + 7 evolutions = 15.
weapon("ember_nova", {
  kind: "nova", damage: 12, cooldown: 1.1, range: 3.8, knockback: 2.5,
  levels: [{ damage: "+30%" }, { range: "+15%" }, { cooldown: "-15%" }, { damage: "+30%" }, { range: "+15%" }, { damage: "+25%", knockback: 3 }],
  evolve: { into: "sun_bell", requires: "bellows" },
});
weapon("spark_bolt", {
  kind: "bolt", damage: 14, cooldown: 0.6, range: 14, speed: 24, pierce: 1, knockback: 2,
  levels: [{ count: 1 }, { damage: "+40%" }, { cooldown: "-20%" }, { pierce: 1 }, { count: 1 }, { damage: "+40%" }],
  evolve: { into: "star_volley", requires: "twin_wick" },
});
weapon("halo_shards", {
  kind: "orbit", damage: 8, cooldown: 0.1, range: 2.4, count: 2, speed: 3.6, knockback: 3,
  levels: [{ count: 1 }, { damage: "+30%" }, { range: "+20%" }, { count: 1 }, { speed: "+25%" }, { damage: "+40%" }],
  evolve: { into: "halo_crown", requires: "lantern_glass" },
});
weapon("cinder_lance", {
  kind: "bolt", damage: 30, cooldown: 1.6, range: 22, speed: 34, pierce: 6, knockback: 4,
  levels: [{ damage: "+30%" }, { pierce: 3 }, { cooldown: "-20%" }, { count: 1 }, { damage: "+40%" }],
  evolve: { into: "sunspear", requires: "kindling" },
});
weapon("ash_whip", {
  kind: "cone", damage: 18, cooldown: 1.1, range: 4, spread: 100, knockback: 6,
  levels: [{ damage: "+30%" }, { spread: 40 }, { range: "+20%" }, { cooldown: "-20%" }, { damage: "+40%" }],
  evolve: { into: "ember_whirl", requires: "swift_boots" },
});
weapon("arc_wire", {
  kind: "chain", damage: 16, cooldown: 1.3, range: 9, count: 2, speed: 4, knockback: 1,
  levels: [{ count: 1 }, { damage: "+35%" }, { count: 1 }, { cooldown: "-20%" }, { count: 2 }],
  evolve: { into: "storm_wire", requires: "lodestone" },
});
weapon("hearth_ring", {
  kind: "aura", damage: 5, cooldown: 0.5, range: 2.5, knockback: 1,
  levels: [{ range: "+20%" }, { damage: "+40%" }, { range: "+20%" }, { cooldown: "-20%" }, { damage: "+40%" }],
  evolve: { into: "bonfire", requires: "hearth_heart" },
});
weapon("falling_star", {
  kind: "meteor", damage: 40, cooldown: 2.2, range: 12, count: 1, blast: 1.8, knockback: 6,
  levels: [{ count: 1 }, { damage: "+40%" }, { cooldown: "-20%" }, { count: 1 }, { damage: "+40%" }],
});

// Evolutions: about x1.7 damage and a new shape. Never offered on their own.
weapon("sun_bell", { kind: "nova", damage: 40, cooldown: 0.8, range: 9, knockback: 9 });
weapon("star_volley", { kind: "bolt", damage: 34, cooldown: 0.4, range: 16, speed: 28, count: 6, pierce: 3, knockback: 3 });
weapon("halo_crown", { kind: "orbit", damage: 20, cooldown: 0.1, range: 3.6, count: 6, speed: 4.5, knockback: 4 });
weapon("sunspear", { kind: "bolt", damage: 80, cooldown: 1, range: 28, speed: 40, count: 3, pierce: 30, knockback: 6 });
weapon("ember_whirl", { kind: "cone", damage: 45, cooldown: 0.8, range: 5.5, spread: 360, knockback: 8 });
weapon("storm_wire", { kind: "chain", damage: 34, cooldown: 0.9, range: 11, count: 9, speed: 5, knockback: 2 });
weapon("bonfire", { kind: "aura", damage: 12, cooldown: 0.4, range: 4.5, knockback: 2 });

// Passive upgrades offered at level-up next to new weapons and weapon levels (up to 8).
// Each evolution pairs with one of them.
upgrade("swift_boots", { stat: "speed", step: 0.07, maxLevel: 5 });
upgrade("hearth_heart", { stat: "maxHealth", step: 20, maxLevel: 5 });
upgrade("lodestone", { stat: "magnet", step: 0.8, maxLevel: 5 });
upgrade("kindling", { stat: "might", step: 0.1, maxLevel: 5 });
upgrade("bellows", { stat: "haste", step: 0.06, maxLevel: 5 });
upgrade("warm_tea", { stat: "regen", step: 1, maxLevel: 3 });
upgrade("lantern_glass", { stat: "area", step: 0.1, maxLevel: 5 });
upgrade("twin_wick", { stat: "amount", step: 1, maxLevel: 2 });

// The run's pacing: a quiet opening that grows into the crowd. Curves are
// [seconds, value] keyframes; spawns land just off screen, never on it.
director({
  // Playtest round 1: danger by 0:30. The first shades reach you by about 0:20, a stream of
  // gnats joins at 0:25, the first elite at 0:45 and the Ash Matron at 1:45.
  start: 10,
  ahead: 0.5,
  alive: [[0, 20], [30, 55], [60, 100], [120, 140], [180, 220], [300, 650], [420, 1300], [540, 2000]],
  rate: [[0, 2], [30, 4], [60, 5], [120, 6], [180, 8], [240, 14], [300, 24], [420, 60], [540, 120]],
  health: [[0, 1], [60, 1.35], [120, 1.7], [180, 2], [300, 3.3], [420, 5.5], [540, 9]],
  // Touches stay survivable; the telegraphed attacks are what should kill you.
  damage: [[0, 1], [60, 1.15], [180, 1.5], [360, 3.2], [480, 4.6], [600, 6]],
  // Late, the swarm closes in faster: kiting forever stops working after 6:00.
  speed: [[0, 1], [240, 1], [360, 1.2], [480, 1.45], [600, 1.6]],
  // Minute 1 is crowded, so each early gem is worth a little less: level 5 still lands near 1:00.
  // Late crowds are bigger, not richer: XP per gem stays flat, so density adds danger rather than power.
  xp: [[0, 0.7], [120, 0.8], [300, 0.8], [540, 0.8]],
  pool: [
    { prefab: "shade", weight: 10 },
    { prefab: "gnat", from: 25, weight: 2, group: [6, 9] },
    // A spitter's slow, telegraphed shot is the first thing that makes kiting cost something.
    { prefab: "spitter", from: 35, weight: 1.5 },
    { prefab: "ram", from: 70, weight: 1.2 },
    { prefab: "husk", from: 90, weight: 3 },
    { prefab: "bloat", from: 240, weight: 3 },
    // After 4:00 the swarm brings its range and its telegraphs back in force: spit, charge lanes and
    // fuse circles you must read and dodge. A perfect kite stops being enough.
    { prefab: "spitter", from: 240, weight: 4 },
    { prefab: "ram", from: 240, weight: 3 },
    { prefab: "aegis", from: 330, weight: 1 },
    { prefab: "mender", from: 330, weight: 1 },
    { prefab: "brute", from: 390, weight: 1 },
    { prefab: "brood", from: 390, weight: 2 },
    { prefab: "caller", from: 450, weight: 1 },
  ],
  fade: { after: 260, weight: 0.3 },
  // Each keeper past the first adds 30% more crowd: a squad spreads out, and the base curve is already sized for one keeper late.
  perPlayer: 0.3,
  // Bodies the cap holds back come back tougher, and worth only a little more.
  crowded: { health: 1.6, damage: 1.25, xp: 1.2 },
  // An elite (x6 health, gold rim) at 0:45, then every 40-55 s.
  elites: { from: 45, every: [40, 55] },
});

/** The hunters: the Ash Matron at 1:45, the Gloam Ram at 4:30, the Bell Warden at ten minutes. */
const MATRON_AT = 105;
const RAM_AT = 270;
const BOSS_AT = 600;

const TIDE_SIDES = ["north", "south", "east", "west"] as const;

system("run", ({ every, after, spawnEdge, emit, respawnDead, on, end, announce, scatter, upcoming }) => {
  scatter("ember_urn", 45);
  scatter("brazier", 12);
  // The HUD counts down to the next hunter.
  upcoming("THE ASH MATRON", MATRON_AT);
  after(MATRON_AT, () => upcoming("THE GLOAM RAM", RAM_AT - MATRON_AT));
  after(RAM_AT, () => upcoming("THE BELL WARDEN", BOSS_AT - RAM_AT));
  // Each minute survived is a wave on the HUD: anyone who bled out comes back.
  every(60, () => {
    emit("wave.cleared");
    respawnDead();
  });
  after(MATRON_AT, () => {
    announce("THE ASH MATRON RISES", { tone: "danger" });
    spawnEdge("ash_matron", { count: 1 });
  });
  after(RAM_AT, () => {
    announce("THE GLOAM RAM CHARGES", { tone: "danger" });
    spawnEdge("gloam_ram", { count: 1 });
  });
  after(BOSS_AT, () => {
    announce("THE BELL TOLLS", { tone: "danger" });
    spawnEdge("bell_warden", { count: 1 });
  });
  // The first minute has teeth: the dark closes in from every side, twice, before the Matron.
  // Break through the ring (dash, or burn a gap) instead of kiting forever.
  for (const at of [35, 80]) {
    after(at, () => {
      announce("THE DARK CLOSES IN", { tone: "danger" });
      spawnEdge("shade", { count: at < 60 ? 30 : 40, side: "any" });
    });
  }
  on("miniboss.killed", () => announce("A HUNTER FALLS · TAKE THE HOARD", { tone: "reward" }));
  on("boss.killed", () => end("won"));
});

// Events: one every 75 s from 4:00, never the same twice in a row, and never while a boss lives.
system("events", ({ every, after, spawnEdge, announce, random, bossAlive, xpBoost, surge, clear, emit, players }) => {
  let last = -1;
  after(240, () => {
    const fire = () => {
      if (bossAlive()) return;
      let pick = Math.floor(random() * 3);
      if (pick === last) pick = (pick + 1) % 3;
      last = pick;
      if (pick === 0) {
        // The Tide: a wall of shades sweeps in from one side.
        const side = TIDE_SIDES[Math.floor(random() * TIDE_SIDES.length)] ?? "north";
        announce("THE TIDE RISES", { tone: "danger" });
        spawnEdge("shade", { count: 220, side, spread: 80 });
        surge(1.5, 20);
        // Still standing when it passes: the Tide is survived.
        after(30, () => emit("tide.survived", players().filter((p) => p.alive).map((p) => p.id)));
      } else if (pick === 1) {
        announce("EMBER HOUR", { tone: "reward" });
        xpBoost(2, 30);
      } else {
        announce("A LANTERN THIEF FLEES", { tone: "reward" });
        spawnEdge("lantern_thief", { count: 1, side: "ahead", spread: 90 });
        after(15, () => {
          clear("lantern_thief");
        });
      }
    };
    fire();
    every(75, fire);
  });
});

// Keepers: pick one before your first level. Each starts with its own weapon and a
// signature passive. New keepers unlock with achievements, never with coins.
keeper("lamplighter", { name: "Lamplighter", text: "A steady nova and a long reach for embers.", weapon: "ember_nova", passive: "lodestone" });
keeper("sparkwright", { name: "Sparkwright", text: "Bolts at range, and quicker hands.", model: "style.lowpoly.rogue", tint: "#7ad7ff", weapon: "spark_bolt", passive: "bellows", unlock: "five_minutes" });
keeper("ash_warden", { name: "Ash Warden", text: "A sweeping whip and swift boots.", model: "style.lowpoly.monarch", tint: "#ff8a4a", weapon: "ash_whip", passive: "swift_boots", unlock: "evolver" });
keeper("star_caller", { name: "Star Caller", text: "Calls stars down; a wider glass.", model: "style.lowpoly.mini_female_c", tint: "#d9a8ff", weapon: "falling_star", passive: "lantern_glass", unlock: "bell_silenced" });

// Achievements (counted in a run; they unlock keepers and pay nothing).
achievement("five_minutes", { title: "Five Minutes of Night", text: "Hold the field for 5:00.", when: "wave.cleared", n: 5 });
achievement("evolver", { title: "Evolved", text: "Evolve a weapon.", when: "player.evolved" });
achievement("bell_silenced", { title: "The Bell Is Silent", text: "Break the Bell Warden.", when: "boss.killed" });
achievement("elite_hunter", { title: "Elite Hunter", text: "Kill 5 elites in one run.", when: "elite.killed", n: 5 });

// Daily goals: the HUD shows three a day. They point at the game's systems and pay nothing.
mission("evolve", { text: "Evolve a weapon", when: "player.evolved" });
mission("elite", { text: "Kill an elite", when: "elite.killed" });
mission("tide", { text: "Survive a Tide", when: "tide.survived" });
mission("revive", { text: "Revive a keeper", when: "player.revived" });
mission("chest", { text: "Open 2 chests", when: "chest.collected", n: 2 });
mission("thief", { text: "Catch the Lantern Thief", when: "lantern_thief.killed" });
mission("matron", { text: "Fell the Ash Matron", when: "miniboss.killed" });

// End-screen titles: who led the run at what.
title("butcher", { text: "The Butcher", most: "kills" });
title("furnace", { text: "The Furnace", most: "damage" });
title("medic", { text: "Field Medic", most: "revives" });
title("untouchable", { text: "Untouchable", least: "downs" });
title("magpie", { text: "Magpie", most: "pickups" });

// Earn (mandatory). Pays the game's coins (1 coin = 1 token), once per run each.
earn.rule("first_light", { when: "wave.cleared", n: 2, pay: 5, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("night_watch", { when: "wave.cleared", n: 7, pay: 20, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("bell_breaker", { when: "boss.killed", n: 1, pay: 50, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("swarm_breaker", { when: "enemy.killed", n: 500, pay: 5, oncePer: "run" });
// Buy-in run (the mandatory sink loop): stake coins at run start to earn above free play.
// A staked run also pays up to stake x multiple, by the share of this run's earn the player makes.
// What it does not win back stays in the reward pool. Values are PLACEHOLDER.
earn.stake({ min: 20, max: 200, multiple: 2 });

// Store (the Kit), priced in coins (the default coin model): a revive used while
// downed, and a cosmetic keeper palette owned for good (kept in the profile).
store.sku("revive", { coins: 50 });
store.sku("skin_aurora", { coins: 300, grants: { cosmetic: 1 } });
// Losable gear: owned for good until lost. It brings one level of its upgrade into every staked run,
// and is lost when that run makes less than loseBelow of its most earn. Values are PLACEHOLDER.
store.sku("ember_charm", { coins: 150, grants: { gear: "kindling", loseBelow: 0.25 } });
```

## Validate and playtest

- Validate: the MCP tool `netforge_validate_game` builds `src/game.ts` and returns one actionable line per problem (an unknown asset id, a missing earn.stake, a bad id). The same checks throw `GameDefinitionError` when the module is imported.
- Playtest: the MCP tool `netforge_run_playtest`, or in code `engine.test.run({ ticks: 30 * 180, bots: 4, assert: [] })`. It reports kills, wave, maxLevel, earned by rule, deaths, runs won and lost, softlock and ms per tick. With `bot: "human"` a human-like bot plays and `report.fun` holds the fun metrics the gate scores (first threat, first level, downs before 1:00, spawns on screen and more).
- Template tests: test/harness.test.ts, test/host.test.ts, test/store.test.ts, run with `npx vitest run` in this package.
- Play locally: put `src/game.ts` and a `netnet.json` of `{"template":"survivor"}` in a folder, install `@netforge/kit-play` and `@netforge/engine`, and run `npx kit-play` (or the MCP tool `netforge_play_locally`). It opens http://127.0.0.1:4663 with play money.
- Docs: https://forge.netnet.capital/docs/templates/survivor
